name: archer_v1
docs: Archer v1 - a synchronous, maker-book based DEX on Solana.

instructions.name: InitializeMarket
docs: Initialize a new market.
Creates the market state PDA (272 bytes) and idempotently creates both vault
ATAs, owned by the market PDA. The market starts Active.
Permissionless. Unless the admin is ARCHER_GLOBAL_AUTHORITY the fees must be
exactly PERMISSIONLESS_MAKER_FEE_PPM (400) / PERMISSIONLESS_TAKER_FEE_PPM (700).
The admin is the market's revenue seat: it collects the 80% share via
CollectProtocolFee, but holds no control over fees, status or the registry.
baseDecimals / quoteDecimals must match the on-chain mints, and either mint is
rejected if it carries an unsupported Token-2022 extension.
takerFeePpm may never be negative - see UpdateTakerFee. makerFeePpm may be.

accounts.name: adminAccount
accounts.desc: Market admin / revenue seat; stored as market.admin

accounts.name: payerAccount
accounts.desc: Pays the market and vault rent

accounts.name: baseTokenProgram
accounts.desc: SPL Token or Token-2022; must own baseMint

accounts.name: quoteTokenProgram
accounts.desc: SPL Token or Token-2022; must own quoteMint

instructions.name: ChangeMarketStatus
docs: Change market status (Active / Paused / Closed).
ARCHER_GLOBAL_AUTHORITY only, on any market. Valid transitions:
Active        -> Paused
Paused        -> Active
Active/Paused -> Closed (irreversible; Closed rejects every transition)

instructions.name: UpdateMakerFee
docs: Update the maker fee.
ARCHER_GLOBAL_AUTHORITY only, on any market, and only while the market is
paused. A market admin sets its fees once at creation and can never change them.
makerFeePpm must lie within [MIN_FEE_PPM, MAX_FEE_PPM] = [-50000, 100000]
(-500bps to 1000bps; negative is a rebate), and makerFeePpm + takerFeePpm must
stay >= 0.

instructions.name: UpdateTakerFee
docs: Update the taker fee.
ARCHER_GLOBAL_AUTHORITY only, on any market, and only while the market is
paused. A market admin sets its fees once at creation and can never change them.
takerFeePpm must lie within [0, MAX_FEE_PPM] = [0, 100000] (0 to 1000bps) and
makerFeePpm + takerFeePpm must stay >= 0.

instructions.name: TransferAdmin
docs: Transfer the market's revenue seat.
Moves the 80% fee share and the right to call CollectProtocolFee to a new
address. It carries no control over fees, status or the maker registry.
Irreversible. The new admin must be non-default and different from the current.
Takes no instruction data - the new admin is read from account 2.

instructions.name: InitializeMakerBook
docs: Initialize a micro order book (MakerBook) for a market maker.
`kind` is init-only and immutable: 0 = MM (levels offset from midPriceTicks),
1 = LO (limit-order book; midPriceTicks pinned to 0, so a level's
priceOffsetTicks IS its absolute price tick). Any other value is rejected.
Empty instruction data defaults to MM, but always send the byte explicitly.
Two funding shapes, selected by whether makerAccount is program-owned:
- wallet maker: it signs and pays the book's rent.
- ArcherAccount maker: makerAccount is the ArcherAccount PDA and pays the rent
from its own lamports (down to its rent-exempt floor) without signing;
authorityAccount holds the signing owner or delegate. The new book records
makerIsArcherAccount = 1.
The market must be Active.

accounts.name: makerAccount
accounts.desc: Wallet maker, which signs; OR the book's ArcherAccount PDA, which cannot sign - in that case pass it with isSigner false and append authorityAccount as the trailing signer. Pays the book's rent either way.

accounts.name: marketAccount
accounts.desc: Market state account; must be Active

accounts.name: authorityAccount
accounts.desc: OPTIONAL. ArcherAccount owner or delegate, signing on the PDA's behalf. REQUIRED iff the maker slot holds an ArcherAccount PDA (a program-owned account); must be omitted otherwise.

instructions.name: UpdateBook
docs: Replace the resting bid/ask levels of a maker book.
WIRE LAYOUT: this instruction does not use borsh. The data buffer is the raw
536-byte UpdateBookData C struct, whose first byte IS this instruction's
discriminator (7). Encoding u8(7) || UpdateBookData as defined here therefore
reproduces the on-chain layout byte for byte:
[0]         discriminator = 7
[1..9)      sequenceNumber   u64 LE
[9..17)     midPriceTicks    u64 LE
[17]        numBids          u8 (<= MAX_LEVELS)
[18]        numAsks          u8 (<= MAX_LEVELS)
[19..24)    padding
Bids and asks each occupy a fixed 16-slot region; numBids/numAsks say how many
leading slots of each are live. sequenceNumber must exceed
makerBook.lastUpdatedSequenceNumber by at least 1 and at most MAX_SEQUENCE_JUMP.
midPriceTicks must be 0 for LO books, which also emit a place/resize/cancel
event per changed level.

accounts.name: makerAccount
accounts.desc: Book maker or book delegate; for an ArcherAccount book, its owner or delegate

accounts.name: marketAccount
accounts.desc: Market state account; must equal makerBook.market

accounts.name: archerAccount
accounts.desc: OPTIONAL. The book's ArcherAccount PDA, read to authorize the signer. REQUIRED iff makerBook.makerIsArcherAccount == 1; must be omitted otherwise.

instructions.name: UpdateMidPrice
docs: Shift the reference (mid) price, moving every level with it.
Cheaper than rewriting the whole book when only the reference moves. Rejected
for LO books, whose mid price is pinned to 0. The quote-side rebalance is
deferred: only midPriceTicks and midAtLastSync move here, and readers replay the
pending shift lazily.
WIRE LAYOUT: raw, 17 bytes - u8(8) || sequenceNumber u64 LE || newMidPriceTicks u64 LE.
ACCOUNT 2 IS PROBED, NOT FIXED. If it parses as a Clock sysvar the slot is read
from it and archerAccount moves to index 3; otherwise the program falls back to
the Clock::get() syscall and index 2 is taken as archerAccount. All four shapes
are valid:
[maker, book]                  [maker, book, archerAccount]
[maker, book, clock]           [maker, book, clock, archerAccount]
The 3-account [maker, book, clock] shape on a wallet-owned book takes a
raw-offset fast path in the entrypoint; every other shape falls through to the
normal handler with identical behavior.

accounts.name: makerAccount
accounts.desc: Book maker or book delegate; for an ArcherAccount book, its owner or delegate

accounts.name: clockSysvar
accounts.desc: OPTIONAL Clock sysvar; when supplied the slot is read directly instead of via the Clock::get() syscall

accounts.name: archerAccount
accounts.desc: OPTIONAL. The book's ArcherAccount PDA, read to authorize the signer. REQUIRED iff makerBook.makerIsArcherAccount == 1; must be omitted otherwise. Sits at index 2 when clockSysvar is omitted.

instructions.name: ClearBook
docs: Clear every resting level and release locked balances back to free.
WIRE LAYOUT: raw, 9 bytes - u8(9) || sequenceNumber u64 LE.
LO books emit a LimitOrderCanceledEvent per cleared level.

accounts.name: makerAccount
accounts.desc: Book maker or book delegate; for an ArcherAccount book, its owner or delegate

accounts.name: archerAccount
accounts.desc: OPTIONAL. The book's ArcherAccount PDA, read to authorize the signer. REQUIRED iff makerBook.makerIsArcherAccount == 1; must be omitted otherwise.

instructions.name: SetBookDelegate
docs: Set or clear the maker book's quoting delegate.
A delegate may update/clear quotes and the mid price, but can never deposit,
withdraw or close the book. Only the book's maker may set it.
Takes no instruction data - the new delegate is read from account 2. Pass the
default pubkey (all zeroes) to clear.

accounts.name: makerAccount
accounts.desc: Wallet maker, which signs; OR the book's ArcherAccount PDA, which cannot sign - in that case pass it with isSigner false and append authorityAccount as the trailing signer.

accounts.name: delegateAccount
accounts.desc: New delegate, or Pubkey::default() to clear

accounts.name: authorityAccount
accounts.desc: OPTIONAL. ArcherAccount owner or delegate, signing on the PDA's behalf. REQUIRED iff the maker slot holds an ArcherAccount PDA (a program-owned account); must be omitted otherwise.

instructions.name: MakerDepositFunds
docs: Deposit base and/or quote funds into a maker book's free balance.
Amounts are in lots; passing 0 for both sides is a no-op. Token-2022 transfer
fees are grossed up so the vault receives the full requested amount. The market
must be Active.
Both vaults and both maker token accounts must be writable even when only one
side carries a non-zero amount.

accounts.name: marketAccount
accounts.desc: Market state account; must be Active

accounts.name: makerAccount
accounts.desc: Wallet maker, which signs; OR the book's ArcherAccount PDA, which cannot sign - in that case pass it with isSigner false and append authorityAccount as the trailing signer. Only the transfer authority - never written.

accounts.name: baseVaultAccount
accounts.desc: Market's base token vault; written by the transfer

accounts.name: quoteVaultAccount
accounts.desc: Market's quote token vault; written by the transfer

accounts.name: authorityAccount
accounts.desc: OPTIONAL. ArcherAccount owner or delegate, signing on the PDA's behalf. REQUIRED iff the maker slot holds an ArcherAccount PDA (a program-owned account); must be omitted otherwise.

instructions.name: MakerWithdrawFunds
docs: Withdraw base and/or quote funds from a maker book's free balance.
Amounts are in lots and may not exceed the free (unlocked) balance. Transfers
out of the vaults are signed by the market PDA. Allowed regardless of market
status, so makers can always exit.
Both vaults and both maker token accounts must be writable even when only one
side carries a non-zero amount.

accounts.name: makerAccount
accounts.desc: Wallet maker, which signs; OR the book's ArcherAccount PDA, which cannot sign - in that case pass it with isSigner false and append authorityAccount as the trailing signer. Only the transfer authority - never written.

accounts.name: baseVaultAccount
accounts.desc: Market's base token vault; written by the transfer

accounts.name: quoteVaultAccount
accounts.desc: Market's quote token vault; written by the transfer

accounts.name: authorityAccount
accounts.desc: OPTIONAL. ArcherAccount owner or delegate, signing on the PDA's behalf. REQUIRED iff the maker slot holds an ArcherAccount PDA (a program-owned account); must be omitted otherwise.

instructions.name: ToggleBookSuspension
docs: Toggle a maker book between Active (1) and Suspended (2).
ARCHER_GLOBAL_AUTHORITY only, on any market. A suspended book is skipped by the
matching engine.
Takes no instruction data - the status is flipped, not supplied.

accounts.name: marketAccount
accounts.desc: Market state account; read only, for the book/market binding check

accounts.name: makerBookAccount
accounts.desc: MakerBook PDA to suspend or reactivate

instructions.name: CollectProtocolFee
docs: Collect accrued protocol fees from the quote vault.
Market admin only. ARCHER_PROTOCOL_FEE_PPM (200000 ppm = 20%) of the collected
amount goes to the Archer treasury and the remainder to the admin. Collecting 0
is a no-op.

accounts.name: quoteVaultAccount
accounts.desc: Market's quote token vault; source of both transfers

instructions.name: Swap
docs: Execute a synchronous Fill-or-Kill swap against aggregated maker liquidity,
with immediate token settlement.
An optional builder ("frontend") fee - builderFeePpm in the params, capped at
MAX_BUILDER_FEE_PPM (10000 ppm = 1%) - is charged on the quote notional traded,
paid by the taker ON TOP of the protocol fee and forwarded to builderFeeWallet.
It never reduces protocol or maker revenue. builderFeeWallet must be supplied
and writable even when the fee is 0.
An 18-byte SwapParams payload (predating builderFeePpm) is still accepted and
read as a 0 fee.
REMAINING ACCOUNTS - not expressible positionally in this IDL. Append them to
`keys` after the fixed accounts, in this order:
[writable] makerBookAccounts - 1..=MAX_MAKER_BOOKS_PER_AUCTION (64) MakerBook PDAs to match against. At least one is required; each must be writable and program-owned; duplicates are rejected.

[] eventAuthority - OPTIONAL, must be LAST if present: Fzo6R5MrDSComspzpQNiieGaYVpNksqeLC27CKTPMTm1. When supplied, SyncFillEvent is emitted via a self-CPI instead of sol_log_data. MakerFillEvent always uses sol_log_data.
BACKWARD COMPAT: legacy callers may still pass the instructions sysvar between
quoteTokenProgram and the first maker book; the program detects and skips it.
New callers must omit it.

accounts.name: taker
accounts.desc: Taker authority; token authority for the input transfer

accounts.name: marketAccount
accounts.desc: Market state account; must be Active

accounts.name: builderFeeWallet
accounts.desc: Quote token account receiving the builder fee. Required and writable even when builderFeePpm is 0.

accounts.name: baseVault
accounts.desc: Market's base token vault PDA; written by settlement

accounts.name: quoteVault
accounts.desc: Market's quote token vault PDA; written by settlement

remainingAccounts: [writable] makerBookAccounts - 1..=MAX_MAKER_BOOKS_PER_AUCTION (64) MakerBook PDAs to match against. At least one is required; each must be writable and program-owned; duplicates are rejected.

[] eventAuthority - OPTIONAL, must be LAST if present: Fzo6R5MrDSComspzpQNiieGaYVpNksqeLC27CKTPMTm1. When supplied, SyncFillEvent is emitted via a self-CPI instead of sol_log_data. MakerFillEvent always uses sol_log_data.

instructions.name: InitializeMakerRegistry
docs: Create the market's MakerRegistry (2128 bytes, up to MAX_REGISTRY_MAKERS = 64).
ARCHER_GLOBAL_AUTHORITY only, on any market; it also pays the rent.
Takes no instruction data.

instructions.name: RegisterMaker
docs: Register a maker book in the market's registry.
ARCHER_GLOBAL_AUTHORITY only. Takes no instruction data. Fails if the registry is full (64) or the book is already registered.

instructions.name: DeregisterMaker
docs: Deregister a maker book in the market's registry.
ARCHER_GLOBAL_AUTHORITY only. Takes no instruction data. Fails if the book is not currently registered.

instructions.name: UpdateExpiryInSlots
docs: Set the maximum staleness of a book's quotes, in slots.
The aggregator skips a book once currentSlot - lastUpdatedSlot exceeds
expiryInSlots. 0 disables the check for this book.

accounts.name: authorityAccount
accounts.desc: Book maker or book delegate; for an ArcherAccount book, its owner or delegate

accounts.name: archerAccount
accounts.desc: OPTIONAL. The book's ArcherAccount PDA, read to authorize the signer. REQUIRED iff makerBook.makerIsArcherAccount == 1; must be omitted otherwise.

instructions.name: CloseMakerBook
docs: Close a MakerBook PDA and refund its rent.
Permissioned by the book's maker - the book delegate cannot close. The book must
be fully empty: baseLocked, quoteLocked, baseFree, quoteFree, totalBidBaseLots
and every bid/ask level all zero.
A SUSPENDED BOOK CANNOT BE CLOSED (MakerBookSuspended, 523)
The rent lands on account 0, which is the wallet maker or the book's
ArcherAccount PDA. Takes no instruction data.

accounts.name: makerAccount
accounts.desc: Wallet maker, which signs; OR the book's ArcherAccount PDA, which cannot sign - in that case pass it with isSigner false and append authorityAccount as the trailing signer. Receives the rent refund.

accounts.name: marketAccount
accounts.desc: Market state account; must equal makerBook.market

accounts.name: authorityAccount
accounts.desc: OPTIONAL. ArcherAccount owner or delegate, signing on the PDA's behalf. REQUIRED iff the maker slot holds an ArcherAccount PDA (a program-owned account); must be omitted otherwise.

instructions.name: InitializeArcherAccount
docs: Create an ArcherAccount - a user's delegated trading identity.
PDA: ["archer-account", owner, platformSeed], where platformSeed is the
DelegatedPlatform's own seed string ("self" for SelfManaged, "treadfi" for
TreadFi) - NOT the numeric discriminant. One wallet may hold one account per
platform, each independently delegated.
`platform` is the DelegatedPlatform discriminant. Empty instruction data
defaults to SelfManaged, but always send the byte explicitly.

accounts.name: payerAccount
accounts.desc: Pays the rent; may be the owner or a platform

instructions.name: SetArcherAccountDelegate
docs: Set or revoke an ArcherAccount's delegate, and its builder-fee ceiling.
Owner only. maxBuilderFeePpm caps builderFeePpm on every taker swap funded by
this account; 0 forbids any builder fee.
The delegate itself is read from account 2 - pass the default pubkey to revoke.

accounts.name: delegateAccount
accounts.desc: New delegate, or Pubkey::default() to revoke

instructions.name: ArcherAccountWithdraw
docs: Move value out of an ArcherAccount. Owner only - a delegate can never withdraw.
Two independent legs, either or both:
- token leg: tokenAmount > 0 moves atoms out of a token account owned by the
ArcherAccount, signed by the account PDA. All four token-leg accounts must be
supplied together or all omitted; supplying only some is rejected.
- lamport leg: lamports > 0 moves lamports to the owner, bounded below by the
account's rent-exempt minimum.

accounts.name: ownerAccount
accounts.desc: The ArcherAccount's owner; receives withdrawn SOL

accounts.name: tokenProgram
accounts.desc: OPTIONAL (token leg). SPL Token or Token-2022

accounts.name: sourceTokenAccount
accounts.desc: OPTIONAL (token leg). Must be owned by the ArcherAccount

accounts.name: destinationTokenAccount
accounts.desc: OPTIONAL (token leg). Must be owned by ownerAccount

instructions.name: SwapFromArcherAccount
docs: A taker swap funded from an ArcherAccount's own token accounts.
The non-custodial market order: the taker is the ArcherAccount PDA, its owner or
delegate signs, and the program signs the token movement on the account's behalf
- so a delegate never gains authority over the user's wallet. Proceeds land back
in the account's token accounts.
builderFeePpm is additionally capped by the account's own maxBuilderFeePpm.
The ArcherAccount does not need a MakerBook on the market being traded; the maker
books in the tail are the counterparties, as in Swap.
This is Swap's layout with two accounts at the front instead of one: the
authority cannot be a trailing account the way it is on every other
ArcherAccount instruction, because Swap's tail is a variable-length maker-book
list that would swallow it.
REMAINING ACCOUNTS - not expressible positionally in this IDL. Append them to
`keys` after the fixed accounts, in this order:
[writable] makerBookAccounts - 1..=MAX_MAKER_BOOKS_PER_AUCTION (64) MakerBook PDAs to match against. At least one is required; each must be writable and program-owned; duplicates are rejected.

[] eventAuthority - OPTIONAL, must be LAST if present: Fzo6R5MrDSComspzpQNiieGaYVpNksqeLC27CKTPMTm1. When supplied, SyncFillEvent is emitted via a self-CPI instead of sol_log_data. MakerFillEvent always uses sol_log_data.
BACKWARD COMPAT: legacy callers may still pass the instructions sysvar between
quoteTokenProgram and the first maker book; the program detects and skips it.
New callers must omit it.

accounts.name: marketAccount
accounts.desc: Market state account; must be Active

accounts.name: builderFeeWallet
accounts.desc: Quote token account receiving the builder fee. Required and writable even when builderFeePpm is 0.

accounts.name: baseVaultAccount
accounts.desc: Market's base token vault PDA; written by settlement

accounts.name: quoteVaultAccount
accounts.desc: Market's quote token vault PDA; written by settlement

accounts.name: takerBaseTokenAccount
accounts.desc: Base token account owned by the ArcherAccount

accounts.name: takerQuoteTokenAccount
accounts.desc: Quote token account owned by the ArcherAccount

remainingAccounts: [writable] makerBookAccounts - 1..=MAX_MAKER_BOOKS_PER_AUCTION (64) MakerBook PDAs to match against. At least one is required; each must be writable and program-owned; duplicates are rejected.

[] eventAuthority - OPTIONAL, must be LAST if present: Fzo6R5MrDSComspzpQNiieGaYVpNksqeLC27CKTPMTm1. When supplied, SyncFillEvent is emitted via a self-CPI instead of sol_log_data. MakerFillEvent always uses sol_log_data.

accounts.name: MarketStateHeader
docs: Market state account. Fixed 272 bytes, no trailing dynamic data.
PDA: ["market", marketId]

fields.name: discriminator
docs: b"ACHRMKT1"

fields.name: marketId
docs: Unique market identifier; the second PDA seed

fields.name: baseVault
docs: ATA of the market PDA for baseMint

fields.name: quoteVault
docs: ATA of the market PDA for quoteMint

fields.name: admin
docs: Revenue seat: collects the 80% fee share. No control over fees, status or the registry.

fields.name: rawBaseUnitsPerBaseUnit
docs: Base unit scaler for sub-unit pricing

fields.name: makerFeePpm
docs: Negative is a rebate

fields.name: takerFeePpm
docs: Always >= 0; the taker side may never be a rebate

fields.name: status
docs: MarketStatus: 0 = Active, 1 = Paused, 2 = Closed

fields.name: reservedPadding1
docs: Reserved. Never read.

fields.name: reservedPadding2
docs: Reserved. Never read.

accounts.name: MakerBook
docs: Per-maker micro order book. Fixed 776 bytes.
PDA: ["maker", market, maker]

fields.name: discriminator
docs: b"ACHRMKR1"

fields.name: maker
docs: Owner of this book: a wallet, or an ArcherAccount PDA when makerIsArcherAccount == 1

fields.name: delegate
docs: Quoting delegate; Pubkey::default() means none. Cannot deposit, withdraw or close.

fields.name: midPriceTicks
docs: Reference price MM levels are offset from. Pinned to 0 for LO books.

fields.name: quoteDeltaPerTick
docs: Internal cache

fields.name: minMidPriceTicks
docs: Internal cache

fields.name: quoteLocked
docs: Quote lots locked by resting bids. Accurate as of midAtLastSync - see that field.

fields.name: quoteFree
docs: Quote lots available for new bids or withdrawal. Accurate as of midAtLastSync.

fields.name: baseLocked
docs: Base lots locked by resting asks

fields.name: baseFree
docs: Base lots available for new asks or withdrawal

fields.name: status
docs: MakerBookStatus: 1 = Active, 2 = Suspended. 0 is never valid.
A Suspended book is skipped by the matching engine and cannot be closed.

fields.name: reservedPadding1
docs: Reserved. Held sync_spread_ticks on pre-v2 books; cleared on first quote update.

fields.name: kind
docs: MAKER_KIND_MM (0) or MAKER_KIND_LO (1). Init-only and immutable.

fields.name: makerIsArcherAccount
docs: 1 when `maker` is an ArcherAccount PDA, 0 when it is a wallet. Init-only.
Decides whether the trailing authority/archerAccount slot is required on
every book-mutating instruction.

fields.name: reservedPadding2
docs: Reserved. Never read.

fields.name: lastUpdatedSequenceNumber
docs: Strictly increasing; each update may advance it by at most MAX_SEQUENCE_JUMP

fields.name: tickConversionNum
docs: Internal cache

fields.name: tickConversionDen
docs: Internal cache

fields.name: lastUpdatedSlot
docs: Slot of the last updateBook / updateMidPrice

fields.name: expiryInSlots
docs: Max staleness before the aggregator skips this book. 0 disables.

fields.name: midAtLastSync
docs: Deferred-rebalancing anchor: the midPriceTicks at which quoteLocked /
quoteFree were last accurate. updateMidPrice defers the quote rebalance, so a
reader must replay the pending shift before trusting those two fields.
0 is a sentinel meaning 'already accurate at the current mid'.

fields.name: reservedPadding3
docs: Reserved. Never read.

accounts.name: MakerRegistry
docs: Registry of the maker books belonging to a market. Fixed 2128 bytes.
PDA: ["maker_registry", market]

fields.name: discriminator
docs: b"ACHRREG1"

fields.name: admin
docs: Copied from the market admin at creation

fields.name: numMakers
docs: Live entries in `makers`

fields.name: reservedPadding1
docs: Reserved. Never read.

fields.name: makers
docs: Registered MakerBook pubkeys; only the first numMakers are meaningful

accounts.name: ArcherAccount
docs: A user's delegated trading identity. Fixed 176 bytes.
PDA: ["archer-account", owner, DelegatedPlatform::seed()]

fields.name: discriminator
docs: b"ACHRACC1"

fields.name: owner
docs: The wallet this account belongs to. The only key that can move value out.

fields.name: delegate
docs: Authorized delegate; Pubkey::default() means none

fields.name: maxBuilderFeePpm
docs: Owner-set ceiling on builderFeePpm for taker swaps funded by this account. 0 forbids any builder fee.

fields.name: platform
docs: DelegatedPlatform discriminant. Its seed() string - not this byte - is the third PDA seed.

fields.name: reservedPadding1
docs: Reserved. Never read.

fields.name: reservedPadding2
docs: Reserved. Zeroed at initialization.

types.name: InitializeMarketParams
docs: Borsh args for InitializeMarket, 202 bytes. FIELD ORDER MATTERS: each token
program pubkey follows its own mint, so the five pubkeys are not grouped as
(mints, programs).

fields.name: marketId
docs: Must be non-default; seeds the market PDA

fields.name: baseDecimals
docs: Must match the on-chain mint

fields.name: quoteDecimals
docs: Must match the on-chain mint

fields.name: makerFeePpm
docs: Must equal PERMISSIONLESS_MAKER_FEE_PPM unless the admin is ARCHER_GLOBAL_AUTHORITY

fields.name: takerFeePpm
docs: Must equal PERMISSIONLESS_TAKER_FEE_PPM unless the admin is ARCHER_GLOBAL_AUTHORITY.
Must be >= 0 in every case: the taker side may never be a rebate.

fields.name: newStatus
docs: MarketStatus: 0 = Active, 1 = Paused, 2 = Closed

fields.name: amount
docs: Quote atoms to collect; 0 is a no-op

types.name: SwapParams
docs: Borsh args for Swap and SwapFromArcherAccount, 22 bytes. The program also
accepts an 18-byte payload that stops after `mode`, for callers built before
builderFeePpm existed; it is read as a 0 fee. New clients should always send 22.

fields.name: amount
docs: Lots. MaxAmountIn: max input to spend - u64::MAX means 'the taker's entire
input token balance'. MinAmountOut: min output to receive.

fields.name: threshold
docs: Lots. MaxAmountIn: min acceptable output. MinAmountOut: max acceptable input.
Must be non-zero in MinAmountOut mode.

fields.name: side
docs: Side: 0 = Bid (buy base), 1 = Ask (sell base)

fields.name: mode
docs: SwapMode: 0 = MaxAmountIn, 1 = MinAmountOut

fields.name: builderFeePpm
docs: Builder (frontend) fee in ppm of the quote notional traded, paid by the taker
on top of the protocol fee and routed to builderFeeWallet. 0 disables it.
Capped at MAX_BUILDER_FEE_PPM (10000), and on SwapFromArcherAccount also by
the account's maxBuilderFeePpm.

types.name: MakerDepositFundsParams
docs: Both 0 is a no-op.

fields.name: expiryInSlots
docs: 0 disables the expiry check for this book

fields.name: maxBuilderFeePpm
docs: 0 forbids any builder fee

fields.name: tokenAmount
docs: Atoms out of the account's token account. 0 skips the token leg.

fields.name: lamports
docs: Lamports to the owner. Bounded below by the rent-exempt minimum.

types.name: UpdateBookData
docs: Raw (non-borsh) payload of UpdateBook. The Rust struct additionally carries a
leading `discriminator: u8` at offset 0, which is exactly the instruction
discriminator byte (7). Encoding u8(7) || this struct reproduces the 536-byte
on-chain layout byte for byte, so the discriminator is deliberately omitted here.

fields.name: sequenceNumber
docs: Must exceed makerBook.lastUpdatedSequenceNumber by 1..=MAX_SEQUENCE_JUMP

fields.name: midPriceTicks
docs: Must be 0 for LO books

fields.name: numBids
docs: Live entries in levels[0..16]; <= MAX_LEVELS

fields.name: numAsks
docs: Live entries in levels[16..32]; <= MAX_LEVELS

fields.name: levels
docs: Fixed two-region array: [0..16] bids, [16..32] asks. Unused slots must be zero.

types.name: MakerLevel
docs: One resting price level. 16 bytes.

fields.name: sizeInBaseLots
docs: 0 means the level is inactive

fields.name: priceOffsetTicks
docs: MM book: signed offset from midPriceTicks; absolute price = mid + offset.
LO book: the absolute price tick itself, since mid is pinned to 0.

types.name: MarketStatus
docs: On-chain u8: Active = 0, Paused = 1, Closed = 2.

types.name: Side
docs: On-chain u8: Bid = 0, Ask = 1.

types.name: SwapMode
docs: On-chain u8: MaxAmountIn = 0, MinAmountOut = 1.

types.name: MakerBookStatus
docs: On-chain u8: Active = 1, Suspended = 2. The Rust enum has no 0 variant and
rejects a 0 byte; `Uninitialized` is listed only so generated clients assign
the correct numeric values to Active and Suspended.

types.name: DelegatedPlatform
docs: On-chain u8: SelfManaged = 0, TreadFi = 1.
The PDA seed is the variant's own string ("self", "treadfi"), NOT this byte.

events.name: SyncFillEvent
docs: One per successful Swap / SwapFromArcherAccount.
Emitted via self-CPI when an event authority is passed, else via sol_log_data.

events.name: MakerFillEvent
docs: One per maker level touched by a fill. ALWAYS emitted via sol_log_data, never
self-CPI, because it can fire hundreds of times in a single swap.
makerIndex is the book's position in the supplied maker-book list.

events.name: LimitOrderPlacedEvent
docs: LO books only. sol_log_data, when UpdateBook adds a level.

events.name: LimitOrderCanceledEvent
docs: LO books only. sol_log_data, when UpdateBook or ClearBook removes a level.

events.name: LimitOrderResizedEvent
docs: LO books only. sol_log_data, when UpdateBook changes a level's size.

errors.name: UnsupportedMintExtension
errors.msg: Token-2022 mint carries an extension unsupported by Archer

errors.name: MintDecimalsMismatch
errors.msg: Declared decimals do not match the mint's decimals

errors.name: TooManyMakerBooks
errors.msg: Too many maker books per swap

errors.name: IncompleteMakerBooks
errors.msg: Incomplete maker books: not all registered makers provided

errors.name: MakerBookHasLockedBalance
errors.msg: Maker book has locked balances; quotes must be cleared before closing

errors.name: MakerBookHasFreeBalance
errors.msg: Maker book has free balances; funds must be withdrawn before closing

errors.name: MakerBookHasActiveLevels
errors.msg: Maker book has active levels; book must be cleared before closing

errors.name: InvalidMakerKind
errors.msg: Invalid maker book kind (must be 0 = MM or 1 = LO)

errors.name: MidPriceImmutableForLimitOrderBook
errors.msg: Mid price is immutable for a limit-order (LO) maker book; must stay 0

errors.name: SequenceNumberTooFarAhead
errors.msg: Sequence number jumps too far ahead of the book's current one

errors.name: MakerBookSuspended
errors.msg: Maker book is suspended; it cannot be closed

errors.name: InsufficientProtocolFees
errors.msg: Insufficient protocol fees to cover rebates

errors.name: BuilderFeeTooHigh
errors.msg: Builder fee exceeds the maximum allowed

errors.name: InvalidPermissionlessFeeConfig
errors.msg: Permissionless markets must launch with the fixed protocol fee config

errors.name: NegativeTakerFeeNotAllowed
errors.msg: Taker fee cannot be negative; only the maker fee may be a rebate

errors.name: FillExceedsMakerAvailable
errors.msg: Fill quantity exceeds maker available liquidity

errors.name: PricePriorityViolated
errors.msg: Price priority ordering violated across levels

errors.name: DustExceedsLevel
errors.msg: Pro-rata distribution exceeds available at level

errors.name: FeeSolvencyViolated
errors.msg: Fee solvency violated: net protocol revenue is negative

errors.name: TokenConservationViolated
errors.msg: Token conservation violated: vault balance mismatch

errors.name: ZeroOutput
errors.msg: Swap produced zero output atoms from nonzero lot trade

errors.name: UnauthorizedArcherAccountDelegate
errors.msg: Signer is neither the ArcherAccount's owner nor its delegate

errors.name: InvalidArcherAccountTokenAccount
errors.msg: Token account is not owned by the ArcherAccount

errors.name: BuilderFeeExceedsAccountCap
errors.msg: Builder fee exceeds the ArcherAccount's owner-set cap

errors.name: InsufficientArcherAccountLamports
errors.msg: Withdrawal would leave the ArcherAccount below rent exemption

docs: Literal "self" for SelfManaged (0) or "treadfi" for TreadFi (1). Not the numeric discriminant.

constants.name: ARCHER_GLOBAL_AUTHORITY
docs: Controls status, fees, book suspension and the registry on every market

constants.name: EVENT_AUTHORITY_PUBKEY
docs: Optional trailing account enabling self-CPI event emission

constants.name: EVENT_IX_TAG
docs: Leading byte of a self-CPI event instruction; the program verifies the event authority signed, then no-ops

constants.name: ARCHER_PROTOCOL_FEE_PPM
docs: Treasury's cut of collected protocol fees (20%)

constants.name: PERMISSIONLESS_MAKER_FEE_PPM
docs: Fixed maker fee every non-global-authority market must use

constants.name: PERMISSIONLESS_TAKER_FEE_PPM
docs: Fixed taker fee every non-global-authority market must use

constants.name: MAX_BUILDER_FEE_PPM
docs: Ceiling on SwapParams.builderFeePpm (1%)

constants.name: MAX_LEVELS
docs: Bid levels and ask levels per maker book

constants.name: MAX_SEQUENCE_JUMP
docs: Largest allowed single advance of lastUpdatedSequenceNumber

constants.name: MAX_MAKER_BOOKS_PER_AUCTION
docs: Maker books one Swap / SwapFromArcherAccount may match against

constants.name: MAKER_KIND_MM
docs: MakerBook.kind: market-maker book, levels offset from midPriceTicks

constants.name: MAKER_KIND_LO
docs: MakerBook.kind: limit-order book, midPriceTicks pinned to 0

constants.name: MARKET_STATE_LEN
docs: Byte size of the market state account

constants.name: MAKER_BOOK_LEN
docs: Byte size of a MakerBook account

constants.name: MAKER_REGISTRY_LEN
docs: Byte size of a MakerRegistry account

constants.name: ARCHER_ACCOUNT_LEN
docs: Byte size of an ArcherAccount

constants.name: UPDATE_BOOK_DATA_LEN
docs: Byte size of the UpdateBook instruction data, discriminator included
